description: Reified 'Publication' collection (WP2.3): a group of related fields modelled as its own Subject.

Publication Actor.description: This field is used to link the documented event of publication to an actor responsible for carrying it out.

Publication Actor Role.description: This field is used to link an activity forming part of the publication process to the person or group participating in a specified role, including any notes or data assignments documenting the source or rationale for the role attribution.

Location of Publication Event.description: This field is used to link the documented event of publication to a location at which it was carried out.

Related Event Causal to Publication.description: This field is used to link the documented publication activity to another event which was the causal reason behind its coming to be.

Publication Type.description: This field is used to record the formal type of the documented event of publication.

Date for Publication Event.description: This field is used to link the documented event of publication to an instance of time-span recording the temporal extent of the activity.
